title: P2 AUG-096 measured win: first scoped ?q= search on a fresh boot 5.72s -> 2.19s (warm) under the prod embedding config — remaining 2.2s is embedding-provider RTT, not index; LM-Studio-local config variant still 9.2s (candidate embed 5.6s)
reasoning: A/B on identical scratch data (8 prod namespace copies, 20MB; same queries; DUCKBRAIN_SEARCH_TIMING=1; daemon on :3114 cold / :3115 first-request). PROD-EMB CONFIG (openai/OpenRouter, what deployment actually runs): COLD (warmup off, .search sidecar deleted, first request) total 5.72s = keyword FTS rebuild 3511.7ms + query_embed 781.2ms + candidate_embed 1324.3ms; WARM (boot rebuilt sidecar) first request 2.19s = keyword 131.5ms + query_embed 841.3ms + candidate_embed 856.0ms. The 3.5s inline FTS rebuild left the request path exactly as AUG-096 intended (~62% cold reduction). Residual 2.2s is provider round-trips (LM Studio on this GPU-loaded node measured 3.3-3.4s per single embed; OpenRouter 0.8-0.9s), NOT index state — further wins require embedding-batch support (batch_supported=false on this provider; embedMany fallback path in search.ts:190) or a faster provider, not more warming. LOCAL-CONFIG VARIANT (lmstudio default): first search 12.74s cold / 9.15s warm-index; warm boot aggregate 44.4s for 9 namespaces (non-blocking, listen() preceded it). Commands: cold 'curl /api/memories?namespace=coding-hermes&q=board+events&limit=5' on fresh daemon DUCKBRAIN_WARM_NAMESPACES=0; warm same on warmed daemon; timing lines '[search-timing] keyword_ms=... query_embedding_ms=... candidate_embed_ms=...' quoted from daemon stderr. Warmup pass itself: 9 ns, 1.46s aggregate prod-emb / 44.4s lmstudio, 0 skipped (corrupt-manifest grading gap filed separately as DF-1013-02).
acceptance_criteria: No action required on AUG-096 itself — measured and working; foreman may close as informative or use the batch-embedding direction for a follow-up PERF row only if a faster-provider/batching change is wanted.
